My current focus is on developing AI-powered productivity software, scalable backend architectures, and full-stack applications. I'm also strengthening my skills in Data Structures & Algorithms, System Design, and Competitive Programming.

overview.problem: People struggle to maintain focus and track productivity over long periods without getting overwhelmed by complex tools.
overview.solution: A full-stack productivity platform combining focus sessions, a task planner, adaptive streak tracking, and behavioral analytics.

gallery.title: Dashboard & Daily Focus
gallery.description: Visualizes daily target progress, adaptive streak metrics, behavioral insights, and prioritized next actions.

gallery.title: Deep Focus Timer
gallery.description: Distraction-free Pomodoro session timer with circular progress tracking, contextual pause tracking, and Zen mode.

gallery.title: Daily Planner
gallery.description: Agenda view connecting planned tasks directly to focus sessions with an active task inventory sidebar.

gallery.title: Task Inventory & Inspector
gallery.description: Comprehensive task manager with priority filters, scheduling status, and detailed task inspector drawer.

gallery.title: Goal Tracking & Milestones
gallery.description: Long-term objective tracker visualizing milestone completion progress and associated sub-tasks.

gallery.title: Planning Notes & Markdown Editor
gallery.description: Integrated rich-text and markdown editor supporting syntax code blocks and study scratchpads alongside tasks.

gallery.title: Timeline & Time-Blocking
gallery.description: Visual day calendar for time-blocking work segments, featuring drag-and-drop task queue and workload advisories.

gallery.title: Work Journal & Session History
gallery.description: Historical work journal with calendar day navigation, planned task records, and logged focus session metrics.

gallery.title: Theme Customization
gallery.description: Custom workspace styling with a suite of curated themes including high-contrast dark modes and vibrant color schemes.

gallery.title: Session & Workflow Settings
gallery.description: Granular configuration for daily focus targets, Pomodoro break intervals, and automated workflow triggers.

gallery.title: Profile & Security Management
gallery.description: User profile dashboard managing account credentials, activity timestamps, session security, and password authentication.

technicalDecisions.decision: Migrating to PostgreSQL for relational consistency
technicalDecisions.reasoning: Provides strict schema enforcement, relational integrity, and ACID guarantees for session telemetry, task hierarchies, and streak tracking.
